Cyber Drills and CTFs

Our CTFROOM Services

As we continue to expand our network of high-impact cybersecurity partners, we are proud to feature CTFROOM Limited. Based in Nairobi, CTFROOM has become a vital player in the African tech ecosystem, specializing in the practical side of cybersecurity: cyber range solutions, Capture The Flag (CTF) hosting, and National CIRT capacity building.

The challenge for most organizations today isn't just buying the right software; it’s ensuring their teams actually have the "muscle memory" to handle a real-world crisis. CTFROOM bridges this gap by providing safe, simulated environments where practitioners can test their skills against live attack scenarios without risking their production systems.

What sets CTFROOM apart is its deep integration with the world’s leading cybersecurity authorities. They are a platform of choice for some of the most respected organizations in the industry. By powering high-stakes drills for these global institutions, CTFROOM has proven its ability to deliver at scale across diverse international contexts, from Kenya and Zambia to the United Arab Emirates and the United States.

Key Accomplishments and Milestones:

CTFROOM’s portfolio is a testament to their commitment to making world-class cybersecurity training both accessible and measurable. Some of their standout contributions include:

Continental Leadership

They were the technical engine behind AfricaCERT Handshake25 in Niger and the Africa Internet Summit Cyber Drill, facilitating critical incident response coordination for national teams across the continent

Nurturing the Talent Pipeline

Through initiatives like the Africa Intervarsity CTF and the Spiro Gladiator CTF (spanning US, India, Nigeria, Kenya, and Tanzania), they have successfully benchmarked and upskilled thousands of emerging professionals and students.

Industry Recognition

From the DSL Exploit X CTF in Zambia to Global Encryption Day challenges, CTFROOM consistently delivers complex, domain-specific training that ranges from basic literacy to advanced exploitation

Why CTFROOM is a Strategic Choice?

From a partner perspective, CTFROOM offers a low-risk, high-impact mechanism for any organisation looking to improve its operational readiness. Their platform is highly flexible, offering SaaS, Managed Hosted, or On-Premise deployments that can be tailored to the strictest security requirements.

Beyond the technology, CTFROOM provides something rare: clear evidence of capability. Their platforms feature instant reporting and performance analytics, allowing leadership to move past "check-the-box" training and see real-time data on their team's proficiency and growth.

We are excited to see CTFROOM continue to lead the way in securing Silicon Savannah and building a sustainable pipeline of cybersecurity talent worldwide

Cyber defense isn’t built in theory, it’s forged in practice. Our cyber drills and CTFs sharpen skills, test resilience, and prepare teams for real-world threats. - Dorian Collier
